name: Catalog search and product detail use live backend data
description: Verify the public catalog, search, product cards, dynamic detail route, price, stock, and add-to-cart affordance are rendered from backend data.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the application home page and wait for the catalog to finish loading.
Verify the page shows 9 products from the live backend, including Everyday Canvas Tote and the TEST123 product named test.
Search the catalog for RF-DC-003 using the Cari produk search box.
Verify only Minimal Desk Lamp remains visible and its Rp329.000 price is shown.
Clear the search and open the Minimal Desk Lamp product detail.
Verify the dynamic detail page displays SKU RF-DC-003, current stock, description, price, and an enabled Tambah ke keranjang button.
